column1: # The declared physical schema of the pinned catalog (VAL-DATA-001).
# The provider-published Arrow feature description of the one immutable pinned
# file, written as the same bounded pre-order record vocabulary the mechanical
# inspection records, so the declared expectation and the recorded schema are
# compared by `Attune.Study.catalogFindings` as ordered values. One record per
# node: depth, field name, shallow Arrow type, nullability. The list element
# nodes and the nested `install_config`/`meta` struct children are part of the
# physical schema and are declared, not skipped.
